label: Finite motor load and whole event projection
definition: The carrier enum has whole, motor and load; proper membership includes motor and load in whole only. ComponentMoves has the single motor-to-load displacement event. InternalMotion witnesses two proper members and that event. PatientLift lifts the patient through membership, preserving the motor; AggregateLift lifts both roles through membership. LocalLift is an open bridge for an arbitrary whole mover predicate restricted to these internal events.
note: Analyst finite interpretation; attribution deferred. Muscle moving a limb motivates the role distinction, without asserting an empirical or physiological theory. A temperature event is excluded by the event definition. Proper membership is neither arbitrary set inclusion nor identity. The component event is not causal sufficiency, transitivity, temporal priority or a proof of biological applicability. No general metaphysical property is assumed. Patient projection represents an internal part moving its organism, whereas aggregate projection represents organism self-motion; neither licenses treating the organism as the identical component. Real applicability and the selection of the root predicate remain OPEN. See docs/notes/motion-mover-fork.md, Part-mediated follow-up. Existing Vitalism turnover and ArrangementDynamics observation projections do not encode this agent/patient event, so their conclusions are not reused as causal premises.
